step_axis: completed optimizer updates; step zero is initialization
name_contract: Readable name plus full SHA-256; names.json preserves full original names and JSON paths. Each event contains the exact scalar projection and a leaf-by-leaf field inventory, including every structured or undefined value.
local_contract: Every observer event is saved before delivery under tracking/events. Checkpoint bytes are copied to objects/step/kind/sha256 before a mutable last/best filename can be replaced. Failure receipts identify undelivered events and files. Delivery has two channels, tracking-server writes and artifact uploads, and a failure on one never skips a delivery on the other. A receipt with delivery_stopped=true ends network delivery on its channel: after a failed backend start on both, so every later event and file stays local; during the run end on the channel whose one bounded attempt failed. A receipt with transport=true and delivery_stopped=false pauses its channel: later deliveries on it are skipped, never replayed, until a probe gets through (an upload probes with itself; a tracking-server write follows a bounded mfm.delivery_status tag probe), first after 60 s, then after a cool-down that doubles per failed probe up to 600 s and resets once a delivery on the channel succeeds. tracking/state.json keeps each channel's open pause and totals; each closed pause is appended to tracking/delivery_pauses.jsonl. The run end waits for no cool-down: a paused channel probes at its first terminal delivery. Every create_run attempt carries the execution's random mfm.start_id tag (start_id in tracking/state.json). After a successful start against a tracking server (http, https or databricks), one bounded search finds running runs that a retried create_run left with the same mfm.start_id; each is tagged mfm.duplicate_of and ended FAILED, and a duplicate_runs event records them. This is housekeeping, not delivery: a failed search or end is a local duplicate_search_failed event with its operation and error_type, pauses nothing and leaves delivery_status unchanged. Canonical run/metrics/evaluations/diagnostics records remain independent.
privacy: Camel/snake/hyphen credential keys, credential-bearing text and URI credentials are redacted before scalar projection. Private/unknown-origin or credential-bearing reports are wholly LOCAL ONLY, including manifests, support summaries, scalars, HTML and figures; the backend receives only safe hash/status receipts. Synthetic report delivery uses the recursive manifest allowlist, never the working directory. No corpus array upload or implicit Hub publication.
catalog_expansion: fields and scalars arrays in each saved event instantiate these producer field patterns for every emitted leaf, so non-headline or newly added producer fields remain represented rather than being silently dropped.
